description.value: The Appletree Family Restaurant is a long-established regional-cuisine breakfast and lunch spot situated in the Admirals Walk shopping centre in View Royal, just outside Victoria. After more than two decades at Hillside Centre, it relocated to its current larger space in May 2013. It operates as a table-service family restaurant, making it a solid sit-down meal option for cyclists passing through the western Greater Victoria corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack at 14m; rack (5 spaces) at 29m; rack at 43m; rack (5 spaces) at 60m; rack at 68m; rack at 87m. Total: 10 spaces.

OSM tags show cuisine=regional and opening_hours=tu-su 08:00-15:00, corroborated by the website's Tuesday–Sunday 8am–3pm hours. The website mentions 'preorders' and 'Breakfast or Lunch Meeting' bookings but does not explicitly describe takeout, bike parking, washrooms, or any other cyclist amenities, so most criteria remain null. One concern: OSM records the name as 'Apple Tree Family Restaurant' (two words) while the website consistently uses 'Appletree Family Restaurant' (one word).
